reports.desc: I contacted the merchant on 9-16-26 after not receiving my merchandise. They indicated that based on their tracking information my items were delivered on 9-16-26. However, I never received any items. I requested a refund and for over two weeks the only response I been given is that they are conducting an investigation with the logistics company.
They come at you with a job offer that you can do on your own, promoting other businesses items.  But eventually you get package deals, upload more money than you have and keep getting negative.
This website is copying listings for our store's inventory and attempting to sell items that they don't have.<br class="t-last-br" />

I placed an order once for face pads from a social media ad. I was emailed about a month later that my credit card was going to be charged again and I was enrolled in a subscription. There was no information regarding a subscription in my order or my confirmtion when I placed the order. I emailed customer service that I did not want this subscription, nor did I sign up for anything. I told them to cancel my order. My credit card was charged again. When I got the email confirmation of the second charge, I emailed them again and this time my emails were replied to by AI just going in circles with the same questions.
The face pads completely fall apart when I try to pull them out of the container. I don't even use them. I certainly don't want more. This company is a nightmare.

An individual from Berry Supply LLC (in my situation "Glen Ishan" or "Glen Ishaan") will reach out to you asking to book with your business for teambuilding, etc. for their employees. Then, they'll ask if you accept credit card and if you will help them make the payout to their professional photographer who will also be coming to the event. They may pay you in full: your services, the photographer's fees, any extra fees you bill them. Then, they will cc you with some bogus photographer email and tell you the photographer must take a direct bank transfer. I'm sure they take all your money if you follow through with all of this. But we're going to get them before they can.
They Said I was getting paid and I never received Pay

We received an invoice for an annual fax plan from this company Med Pulse.

They offer airline flight tickets.   They showed a price for the flights.   They take you to a place to pay and show you the total you will pay for the flights, and you use your C.C. to pay for them.    Then they call you later that day and tell you that you are a "restricted" status.   Then told me that my flight can change price and that they had already changed the date for my return flight by 1 day.   When I told them it didn't work they offered my the same flights for $700 more than I had paid.  When I declined they said to cancel I would forfeit a $200  for a cancellation fee.    I argued with them for an hour and they eventually gave me the same flights for $450 more than I had paid, but still $150 more than the price from a legitimate travel agency.  I had non refundable hotel accommodations so I had no choice but to accept the $150 loss rather than the $200 cancellation fee.

I received a phone call from an unknown number and did not answer. The caller left a voicemail stating that they had seen my resume online. However, they did not specify where they found my resume or the website where my resume was allegedly posted.
The caller stated that there was a job opening but did not identify the position or provide any specific details about the job. He asked whether I was still looking for employment and requested that I call or text him back.
He also directed me to visit a website and read the reviews. As I was doing so, I did not find the website. I found a BBB review describing a situation that appeared similar to my experience.
I became concerned that this may be a potential employment scam. I am submitting this report to document the contact and bring the situation to BBB's attention.

Scammer reached out to me about a job I never applied to. They sent fake offer letters via email, reached out on Google Chat, and promised a remote position, 30 days of PTO, and reimbursement for work equipment.
The tracker said items delivered. From date of order it took 23 days and I never received the merchandise.
Attachment is the fake offer letter sent to my email.
